messages.text:
At 0.145 €/kWh the KBOX's 330 W runs about €34 a month in power, and it's $800. You're buying a real block draw every ten minutes plus steady sats to your own wallet — the machine stays yours.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
i've a little bitaxe supra
Ran the power-cost calculator · 14.5¢/kWh
Read the gekkoscience kbox 22 th s page

Big step up from the Supra — 22 TH/s versus about 1. Honestly though, the Magic Miner 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s, so nearly double the hashrate for the same money. Trade-off: the KBOX is in stock now, the 40T is a pre-sale that ships Nov 14, 2026.

Which matters more to you — having it this month, or the hashrate?
one month wait it's not a problem i want a silence home miner

Then be honest with yourself about noise: at 330 W the KBOX barely has heat to shift, and its case and speed-controlled fans are built around being quiet. The 40T pushes nearly double the hashrate, so more heat and more fan.

Where's it going to sit — office, bedroom, or somewhere you won't hear it?
i'll put it in the living room where i work. it's near bedroom i almost want silence during night or bed time

Then the KBOX is your unit. It has High, Medium and Low presets — 22, 16 or 10 TH/s — so you can drop it to Low at bedtime and the fans go right down, then back up in the morning.

$800, in stock, and it's the quietest thing we'd put next to a bedroom. Want me to build the checkout?
magic miner does not have different presets?
Read the magic miner 40t page

It does — 30 TH/s at 450 W, 40 at 650 W, 50 at 850 W. But its lowest mode is ~50 dB and still pulls more power than the KBOX does flat out, so it's not a bedroom-wall machine.

KBOX on Low is the quiet answer. €34 a month in power versus about €47 for the 40T in Eco. Shall I build it?
i see these are based on bm1370 chip. nothing on newest one?
Read the bsb b30 page

Yes — the Harlo B30 runs the newer BM1373, $899, 30 TH/s at 360–450 W. It's the only enclosed home miner built on that chip.

But it's also rated ~50 dB, same as the 40T, and it's a pre-sale shipping Nov 30, 2026. Newest silicon, not the quietest box.

Quiet next to the bedroom is still the KBOX.
how much the eu shipping and taxes costs?

Shipping on the KBOX to Europe is $35 (it ships from the US). 

Taxes aren't collected at checkout: 21% import VAT plus any duty is charged by the carrier on delivery, so roughly $168 on the $800. We can't quote what your customs office raises exactly.

Which country are you in? A couple have different rates.
italy

Italy's the standard case: $800 + $35 shipping, then 21% import VAT and any duty on delivery — about $175, so call it a bit over $1,000 landed. Nothing tax-wise is taken at checkout.

The P. takes 120/240 V, so it's fine on Italian mains. Want me to build the checkout?
i see Import VAT included in price - Ships from within EU on kbox page

Good catch, and I'm not going to guess on that. The K. is built and shipped by GekkoScience in the US, which is why I gave you the import-VAT answer — but if your page is showing the EU-warehouse line, those two don't agree and the difference is about $175 to you.

I've put it to Georges to confirm which is right. The team picks it up today at 10am ET and you'll get the answer by email. The $800 and the $35 shipping are firm either way.
Handed to the team · Page VAT line contradicts the US-shipped rule for the KBOX; ~$175 difference to
Anything else I can dig into while you wait — the noise side, or how it sets up on your network?
there's another efficient & silent home miner?
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe NerdQaxe BC04 quiet small bitcoin miner

Two worth knowing, both buyable to Italy:

Hammer Thor P2 — 10 TH/s at 166 W, rated ~40 dB, $369, ships Oct 3, 2026. Quietest number on any of our sheets and about €17/month in power at your rate.

NerdQX — 8 TH/s at 145 W, ~40 dB, $299.99, in stock.

Both are a third of the KBOX's hashrate though. Quiet or hashrate — which wins?
